analyst.summary: Afcons Infrastructure is a large EPC contractor (Shapoorji Pallonji group) specializing in marine, tunneling, and metro construction, with a big order book that gives good revenue visibility. The full year was still profitable, but the most recent quarter was notably weak -- revenue fell and operating margins roughly halved -- and the pace at which new orders are replacing completed work has slowed relative to the size of the backlog. The balance sheet itself is not a concern, but the recent margin volatility is.
